items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: We played for some dancers... this guy Scanley(?) was an alcoholic... So the guy said, 'Look, Scanley, you can stay here and clap you hands around the band'

ctx.x: Did you play for dancers with this band?

We played for some dancers. When we got to Los Angeles here, we had somebody booking these guys. They got us playing a banquet in Huntington Park, at an iron foundry; they was having some kind of big get-together. And this guy Scanley(?) was an alcoholic. And some guy says, "This guy Scanley(?) is all right, but you guys watch him. If he ever gets drunk, he's hell born over. He's a living devil." I said, "I can't believe Scanley..." He's such a nice guy sober!
